label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo078Subtitle
text: *Please, General, don't sell-off what I could destroy for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo079Subtitle
text: *General, you're not playing fair. Now go step on some traps

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo080Subtitle
text: *You're exceptionally lucky, General, but you can't avoid my Demo Traps forever

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo081Subtitle
text: *No one has beaten my traps, General, and you won't be the firstyou'll see

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo082Subtitle
text: *Do you think you're beating me, General? This could change in an instant--I don't fight fair

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo083Subtitle
text: *You may have defeated me, General, but Deathstrike will avenge me

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo084Subtitle
text: *Ha ha! Your troops are falling to my traps, General. Soon they'll all be gone

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo085Subtitle
text: *You're losing, General. My tactics elude you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo086Subtitle
text: *You'll never defeat me, General. You should leave before you get hurt

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo087Subtitle
text: *I have so many explosives leftmore explosives than you have forces I'm afraid

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo088Subtitle
text: *You lose, General. Too bad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo089Subtitle
text: *I have just the thing. Let's go make war

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo090Subtitle
text: *Demolitions expert: How can I help you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo091Subtitle
text: *I wonder if I could wire that button to explode?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo092Subtitle
text: *Please, General--enter my battlefieldbut watch where to step

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo093Subtitle
text: *You were lucky this time, General. You could never beat me again

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo094Subtitle
text: *You were not prepared for this kind of war. Try again, if you dare

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo095Subtitle
text: *Here we see the battlefield--openuntouched by battlea blank slate for our little...

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo096Subtitle
text: *Now where did those Demo Traps come from?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Demo097Subtitle
text: *Perhaps I have a few cards hidden up my sleeve, but did you except any less from me, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger001Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, you ever seen a Raptor up close?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger002Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, did you see that Stealth Fighter?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger003Subtitle
text: *Birds' away! Let's go hunt some dozers!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger004Subtitle
text: *I'm done playing with you, General. (Announcing to his own forces) Everyone attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger005Subtitle
text: *Will you look at thatUS military spending at its best

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger006Subtitle
text: *(Singingbadly)and the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger007Subtitle
text: *Here comes the rain of terror, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger008Subtitle
text: *How are you enjoying the Shock-and-Awe, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger009Subtitle
text: *Death from above!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger010Subtitle
text: *It doesn't seem fair, does it, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger011Subtitle
text: *It's time to pull the goalies. Everyone attack!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger012Subtitle
text: *Bombs away!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger013Subtitle
text: *It's awfully quiet out thereyou didn't leave did you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger014Subtitle
text: *Don't worry, General, this is just the quiet before the storm

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger015Subtitle
text: *I'd take this break to rebuild your defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger016Subtitle
text: *Shhdid you hear that? I wouldn't worry, it's probably nothing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger017Subtitle
text: *Sorry, General, we're just taking a lunch-break-be with you in a minute

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger018Subtitle
text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger019Subtitle
text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger020Subtitle
text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger021Subtitle
text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger022Subtitle
text: *Ouch, that must have been expensive

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger023Subtitle
text: *Huh, where are you going to train your troops now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger024Subtitle
text: *Having trouble keeping up those defenses, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger025Subtitle
text: *You've lost a lot of buildings, General; were you planning on using harsh language now?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger026Subtitle
text: *Dozers, start repairing our buildings!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger027Subtitle
text: *I'll get you for this, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger028Subtitle
text: *You'll regret destroying that airfield, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger029Subtitle
text: *Dozers, rebuild our defenses!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger030Subtitle
text: *This is General Granger to Aircraft Carrier Olympia: Send reinforcementsrepeat: send reinforcements

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger031Subtitle
text: *They're attacking the Command Center! All forces, regroup!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger032Subtitle
text: *I don't appreciate you shooting down my planes, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger033Subtitle
text: *They're taking over our Oil Derricks! Rangers, get out there and take them back!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger034Subtitle
text: *Get out of our base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger035Subtitle
text: *Get out of my airspace, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger036Subtitle
text: *The enemy's in our perimeter! All planes return to base!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger037Subtitle
text: *Ground forces, defend the airfields!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger038Subtitle
text: *You're not stealing my supplies, are you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger039Subtitle
text: *They're coming in the back-door!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger040Subtitle
text: *Hiding in the village, huh. That's a coward's tactic, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger041Subtitle
text: *Stop hiding, General. Don't make me come and get you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger042Subtitle
text: *They're at the East gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger043Subtitle
text: *Defend the East side!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger044Subtitle
text: *Enemy forces approaching the West gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger045Subtitle
text: *All forces to the West gate!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger046Subtitle
text: *Having trouble keeping your power up, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger047Subtitle
text: *Oops, your power's down - here come the bombs!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger048Subtitle
text: *Out of resources, General? Want to borrow some?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger049Subtitle
text: *Hey, General, how 'bout we call this one a draw?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger050Subtitle
text: *You may have won the battle, General, but the war is far from over

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger051Subtitle
text: *So, you built a Scud Storm. Think you can defend it?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger052Subtitle
text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General Think it will be enough to calm the fear?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger053Subtitle
text: *Your tanks are no match for my planes, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger054Subtitle
text: *Anthrax! Everyone find cover!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger055Subtitle
text: *Garrison all the buildings you want, General-it won't help

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger056Subtitle
text: *How much more of this can you take, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger057Subtitle
text: *Ready to surrender yet?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger058Subtitle
text: *Haven't you lost enough troops, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger059Subtitle
text: *This battle is over, General-surrender or prepare to die!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger060Subtitle
text: *Not going to surrender, huh? Too bad

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger061Subtitle
text: *Bombs away, punk

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger062Subtitle
text: *Come on, General--I'll show you the meaning of "Death from Above."

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger063Subtitle
text: *Sonic-boom, baby. Let's do this thing

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger064Subtitle
text: *I guess it's time for me to go find a good airline job

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger065Subtitle
text: *I win--you lose. What more is there to say?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger066Subtitle
text: *Be advised: This area is under the control of Air Force General Malcolm Granger. Withdraw now or prepare to be bombed back to the stone-age

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger067Subtitle
text: *General, you're no match for me--I own the skies!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger068Subtitle
text: *Watch the skies, General; we're going to put on an air-show

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger069Subtitle
text: *Wanna see it again?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger070Subtitle
text: *Ready-or-not, here I come!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger071Subtitle
text: *You don't mind if we drop-in, do ya General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger072Subtitle
text: *That's two of my airfields you've hit, General. I'm starting to get annoyed

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger073Subtitle
text: *Curse you, General. If you hit another airfield I'll come for you personally

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger074Subtitle
text: *That's the last airfield you destroy today. (Announcing to his own troops) Forces, target their Command Center

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger075Subtitle
text: *I can't believe you beat me, General. I salute your superior tactics

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger076Subtitle
text: *It looks like you defeated me this time, General, but we'll meet again someday and I won't be so merciful because-

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger077Subtitle
text: *I thought he'd never shut up

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger078Subtitle
text: *You don't think I'm going to let you keep that Scud Storm, do you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger079Subtitle
text: *Another Scud Storm? I guess it's time to take the up a notch

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger080Subtitle
text: *Pilots, watch-out for those Stinger Sites

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger081Subtitle
text: *So many Rangers-so few buildings to capture

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger082Subtitle
text: *General, do ya know how a Fuel-Air Bomb works? How 'bout a demonstration?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger083Subtitle
text: *Welcome to the party, Colonel Burton. You're in for it now, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger084Subtitle
text: *Do you know how to stop an A-10, General? Me neither

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger085Subtitle
text: *Hey, wanna see our new Bunker Buster?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger086Subtitle
text: *Artillery! You think you can attack me with artillery?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger087Subtitle
text: *You know that Scud Launcher is never going to make it to my base, right?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger088Subtitle
text: *Wait, that's a Bomb Truck! Everyone look out!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger089Subtitle
text: *You've forced me to use tanksI hate using tanks

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger090Subtitle
text: *Having trouble crossing the river, General? Wanna lift?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger091Subtitle
text: *Cowards! Stop hiding and fight!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger092Subtitle
text: *Stealth won't save you, General; we'll find you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Grainger093Subtitle
text: *Hmm, that's a lot of anti-air, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry001Subtitle
text: *So, this is where you're hiding, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry002Subtitle
text: *<sarcastic>Feeling overwhelmed General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry003Subtitle
text: *(Chinese infantry troops die) <angry voice> 1 billion more where that came from

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry004Subtitle
text: *(Paradrop)Like a swarm of locusts they descend from the sky to devour all those who stand against China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry005Subtitle
text: *Ever been hacked General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry006Subtitle
text: *<shouting>March!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry007Subtitle
text: *They make good shields too

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry008Subtitle
text: *Here's a tip General, Surrender!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry009Subtitle
text: *Don't worry General, we don't take prisoners

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry010Subtitle
text: *Unleash Horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry011Subtitle
text: *It's ok General, we've brought our own flag for your base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry012Subtitle
text: *Soon all your men will see are boots marching over them

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry013Subtitle
text: *Charge!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry014Subtitle
text: *Death to all who oppose us!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry015Subtitle
text: *Do you know how hard it is to feed a horde, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry016Subtitle
text: *I have enough men to hold a parade. Can we have it in your base?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry017Subtitle
text: *Are you still here, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry018Subtitle
text: *Are you just going to sit there and wait to be overrun?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry019Subtitle
text: *Are your resources getting low, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry020Subtitle
text: *How long does it take for you to build your little tank force?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry021Subtitle
text: *<sarcastic> What tactic will you amaze me with now, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry022Subtitle
text: *This can't be the best you can do, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry023Subtitle
text: *So far I'm not impressed, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry024Subtitle
text: *You were not prepared for this challenge, were you, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry025Subtitle
text: *I have enough men to crush you without firing a shot

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry026Subtitle
text: *We are coming for you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry027Subtitle
text: *Awwwe've knocked over your little Tech Building. Boo-hoo

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry028Subtitle
text: *Now your Barracks is gone. How will you fight without men?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry029Subtitle
text: *Without a War Factory you'll have to fight me man-to-man, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry030Subtitle
text: *No more planes for you. Get on the ground and fight like a man

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry031Subtitle
text: *My men are marching right through you base defenses, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry032Subtitle
text: *There is only empty ground where your Command Center once stood, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry033Subtitle
text: *I have lost many men, General, but the cost to your buildings has been worth it

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry034Subtitle
text: *Leave my Tech Buildings alone, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry035Subtitle
text: *NO! Not my Barracks! We will build another, Generalthen you will pay

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry036Subtitle
text: *My War Factory is not essential to my victory, but do not destroy another

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry037Subtitle
text: *You have destroyed my Air Field! This is getting annoying, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry038Subtitle
text: *Destroy all the base defenses you want--they're only there to slow you down anyway

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry039Subtitle
text: *You have cost me many buildings, General. My men are coming to collect repayment

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry040Subtitle
text: *Nooo! They destroyed my Command Center! Go get them! Keep them away from me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry041Subtitle
text: *Swat all the planes you like, General--we'll make more

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry042Subtitle
text: *My vehicles are not for your target practice, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry043Subtitle
text: *There are many more in my army ready to sacrifice for China, General. You won't stop us

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry044Subtitle
text: *I see you've captured my Oil Derrick, General. We are coming to take back China's oil now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry045Subtitle
text: *That old Artillery Platform is destroyed, General; you'll never get it to work

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry046Subtitle
text: *Do you think that Oil Refinery is just there for anyone to use? Return the refinery to me now

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry047Subtitle
text: *Get any closer to my base and I'll set the horde out on you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry048Subtitle
text: *I warn you, General, get away from my base. Do you know what a hundred men can do to a tank?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry049Subtitle
text: *They're in our base! Kill them! Get them out of here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry050Subtitle
text: *They're getting too close! Protect me!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry051Subtitle
text: *General, get away from my resources--my men need those

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry052Subtitle
text: *General, do not try to flank my base

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry053Subtitle
text: *A back-door attack will not help you, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry054Subtitle
text: *Attacking the front of my base is foolish, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry055Subtitle
text: *Those are my Tech Buildings, General. Stay away

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry056Subtitle
text: *Get out of my buildings, General!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry057Subtitle
text: *Crossing that bridge is a mistake, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry058Subtitle
text: *You've run out of power, General--your defenses are down and my men will invade soon

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry059Subtitle
text: *Without power you'll never stop my horde, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry060Subtitle
text: *You've wasted all your resources fighting my menbut I still have more men

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry061Subtitle
text: *We are out of resources! How did this happen?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry062Subtitle
text: *Build your Scud Storm--it will only hit a few of my menthe rest will destroy you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry063Subtitle
text: *I thought nuclear missile were not allowed! This is hardly fair, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry064Subtitle
text: *That Particle Cannon is useless against my horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry065Subtitle
text: *Yes, you should build more base defenses--at least then you can stop the first wave of the charging horde

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry066Subtitle
text: *Coward! You know that your tanks cannot crush my men, don't you?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry067Subtitle
text: *So many planesno matter, my horde and bring down your planes too

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry068Subtitle
text: *You're mobilizing a horde of your own?! You will need many more men to match my strength, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry069Subtitle
text: *You base has grown too large, General. It is time for my men to drop in and capture a few for China

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry070Subtitle
text: *Scud Storm! Scatter!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry071Subtitle
text: *Nuclear missile approaching! Flee! Get me out of here!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry072Subtitle
text: *Ooh, look at the pretty light show. What do you hope to accomplish with that petty weapon, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry073Subtitle
text: *Get out of that building, General. We have ways of bringing you out by force if necessary

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry074Subtitle
text: *You've brought Colonel Burton to our little war, General. Even he will fall when faced with the horde

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry075Subtitle
text: *Black Lotus? How will she help you survive my horde, General?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry076Subtitle
text: *All forces beware: Jarmen Kell is hiding in the field

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry077Subtitle
text: *I see that Air Field, General. Run to the air! Fear my horde!

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry078Subtitle
text: *My men will tear your tanks apart as fast as you can make them, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry079Subtitle
text: *My men are trained in groups of threehow fast can you train your men?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry080Subtitle
text: *Selling your buildings? Foolish! What will you buy with the money to stop my horde?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry081Subtitle
text: *I have so many forces, how can you be winning this battle?

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry082Subtitle
text: *I have underestimated your tactics, General

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry083Subtitle
text: *You've caught me off guard, General, but now I am ready for you

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry084Subtitle
text: *You will not defeat my horde, General! Your current advantage will soon be lost

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry085Subtitle
text: *I do not accept this defeat, General. My men will cover my escape and we will fight another day

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry086Subtitle
text: *My men outnumber you now, General. I would be wise to surrender

label: DIALOGEVENT:Taunts_Infantry087Subtitle
text: *This looks like the end for you, General
